principal.message: Welcome to the official website of SMK Telkom Sidoarjo. As a leading vocational education institution specializing in technology and informatics, we are dedicated to developing a generation that not only excels in industry competencies, but is also resilient, character-driven, and ready to pioneer the digital era. We hope this portal serves as an informative window for all.

why.card1Desc: Focusing on future-ready digital curricula and advanced technology skills.
why.card2Desc: Equipping students with in-demand digital competencies for industry and startups.
why.card3Desc: Nationally recognized with the highest quality benchmarks by BAN-S/M.
why.card4Desc: Operating under international educational organization management standards.
why.card5Desc: Seamless pathway from vocational high school to Telkom university level.
why.card6Desc: Part of the reputable national educational group under Telkom Indonesia.

programs.sijaDesc: A comprehensive 4-year curriculum combining Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, Cyber Security, and Internet of Things (IoT) to cultivate world-class software engineers and network architects.
programs.tjatDesc: Preparing next-generation telecom engineers specialized in Fiber Optics deployment and maintenance, VSAT infrastructure, wireless systems, and modern cellular technologies.
